title: [Save] Live host silently deletes saves beyond 10 slots; C++ never deletes and numbers to 99999999
description: C++ GameState::saveGame never deletes; findNextSaveFilename LOWEST_NUMBER %08d.sav up to 99999999. Live SaveFileManager::enforce_save_limit deletes oldest past MAX_SAVE_SLOTS=10 after every save (save_file.rs). Popup next_popup_save_slot was save_01..save_10. Player-visible data loss including leftover mission saves in the same UserData/Save dir. Host-invented cleanup_old_auto_saves keeps 5. Fix: drop deletion; allocate lowest unused 8-digit slot. Partial fix already landed this session.

title: [Weapon] Splash RadiusDamageAffects uses faction-Team equality, not Player relationship
description: C++ Weapon.cpp:1332-1372 dealDamageInternal uses curVictim->getRelationship(source) (Player.cpp:542-571) then AFFECTS_ALLIES/ENEMIES/NEUTRALS. Live radius_damage_affects_victim (weapon_bootstrap/collide.rs:103-140) uses shooter_team==victim_team. Impact snapshot combat.rs:672-677 freezes no owner. Microwave/ECM same_team skip. Player-visible: mirror/FFA USA-vs-USA splash/microwave/ECM do nothing to same-faction enemies.

title: Skirmish command-button-ready script conditions/waits never check readiness on live host
description: C++ ScriptConditions.cpp:2269-2306 evaluateSkirmishCommandButtonIsReady tests per-object special-power/upgrade readiness. Live dispatcher helper (executor/dispatch.rs:1590) is button-existence-only; leftover eval_skirmish.rs:381 reads empty OBJECT_REGISTRY so ALL vacuously true / PARTIAL always false. Sequential WAIT_FOR_COMMANDBUTTON_AVAILABLE completes immediately. Player-visible: skirmish AI fires powers on cooldown.

title: [Shadow] Template Shadow authoring never reaches live shadows
description: C++ W3DModelDraw allocateShadows/setModelState gated on Shadow!=NONE; uses ShadowTexture/Size/Offset from ThingTemplate. Live Main parses ShadowSizeX/Y but never Shadow bitstring; leftover apply_terrain_decal hardcodes texture 'shadow' and geometry-radius size. Player-visible: Shadow=NONE props still get discs; authored sizes/offsets ignored.

title: [Loco] Stunned/airborne units keep marching — no getIsStunned or AllowAirborneMotiveForce gate
description: C++ Locomotor.cpp:836-841 returns immediately when physics->getIsStunned(); :1064-1066 skips motive unless AllowAirborneMotiveForce. Leftover move_dispatch.rs ports both. Live world_tick/movement.rs gates only is_disabled(); shock_stun_frames units keep blending march velocity. Player-visible: tossed units run mid-air instead of ragdolling.

title: [Physics] Living AI units stiffness-bounce off immobile objects
description: C++ PhysicsUpdate.cpp:1270-1280 + AIUpdate.cpp:1410-1426 processCollision returns FALSE when aiOther==NULL so living units steer vs buildings; stiffness rebound is dead/parachute only. Live try_physics_collide applies apply_structure_stiffness_bounce to every allow_collide_force mover. Player-visible: units stutter/lurch along walls.

title: [ControlBar] Enemy/ally selection shows their command strip and garrison inventory
description: C++ ControlBar::evaluateContextUI + InGameUI::areSelectedObjectsControllable: non-local selection → CB_CONTEXT_NONE blank strip. Live unit_command_buttons and leftover evaluate_context_ui have no ownership gate; apply_presentation_selection_residual feeds enemy ids. Player-visible: click enemy War Factory → its build cameos in your strip.

title: [Contain] Booby-trapped building never detonates when an enemy garrisons/enters it
description: C++ OpenContain::addToContain → Object::checkAndDetonateBoobyTrap(rider). Leftover should_cancel_containment_after_booby_trap is wired. Live detonates only on capture-prep and death. Player-visible: Demo trap on garrisonable building does nothing when enemy garrisons.

title: [Drawable/Sway] Tree sway uses hardcoded synchronized breeze
description: C++ ScriptEngine breeze defaults period 150, intensity 0.07*PI/4, randomness 0.2; MAP_SET_SWAY bumps version. Live impl_gpu.rs hardcodes BreezeInfo period 60 intensity 0.03 with min RNG so all trees lockstep. Script setSway never reaches tree buffer.

title: [Drawable/TankDraw] Tread move-debris never spawns
description: C++ W3DTankDraw TrackDebrisDirtLeft/Right start when moving. Leftover w3d_tank_draw.rs ports it unused. Live only scrolls tread UVs. Player-visible: tanks drive with no tread dirt/dust.

title: [Drawable/TruckDraw] Dust/DirtSpray/PowerslideSpray FX and truck landing/powerslide sounds never run
description: C++ W3DTruckDraw createEmitters + landing/powerslide audio. Leftover ports unused. Live has no Dust/DirtSpray/PowerslideSpray. Player-visible: Humvees/trucks have no rolling dust or landing thump.

title: [DropZone] Disabled/underpowered Supply Drop Zone keeps airdropping cash
description: C++ OCLUpdate.cpp:102-106 freezes timer while isDisabled(); brownout sets DISABLED_UNDERPOWERED on KINDOF_POWERED. Live update_supply_drop_zone_drops gates only alive/constructed/neutral. Player-visible: USA brownout still gets $1500 drops every 120s.

title: [ScriptAct] TEAM/NAMED HUNT, GUARD, and PLAYER_HUNT never reach live units
description: C++ doTeamHunt/doNamedHunt/doTeamGuard/doNamedGuard/doPlayerHunt command live AI. Leftover implements against empty OBJECT_REGISTRY with no host bridge. Live drains only move/attack/guard-supply-center. Player-visible: campaign hunt/guard scripts leave armies at spawn.

title: [ScriptAct] Guard-variant team orders lose their anchor
description: C++ doTeamGuardPosition/Object/Area/TunnelNetwork guard the scripted anchor. Leftover dual-world only. Live OnCreate collapses all to guard-at-current-position. Player-visible: defenders guard barracks ramp not the objective.

title: [ScriptAct] TEAM/NAMED FOLLOW_WAYPOINTS never reach live units
description: C++ doNamed/TeamFollowWaypoints resolve path and issue follow. Leftover leftover-only. Live HostScriptMoveAttackRequest has no FollowWaypoints. Player-visible: convoy/wave waypoint paths freeze after single-move.

title: [Save/CommandSet] Live save/load drops object command_set_override
description: C++ Object::xfer persists m_commandSetStringOverride. Leftover object_xfer.rs:1070 xfers it. Live snapshot has no field. Player-visible: load after ChinaMines/SatelliteHack/Overlord addon/Demo SuicideBomb → base command set returns.

title: [ControlBar] Right-HUD upgrade cameos from applied_upgrades, not UpgradeCameo1..5
description: C++ setPortraitByObject iterates authored UpgradeCameo1..5 with disabled-preview until complete. Live Main ThingTemplate never parses those keys; leftover impl_portrait.rs builds from applied_upgrades alphabetical. Player-visible: missing preview cameos / extra wrong cameos.

description: C++ MilesAudioManager isPlayingLowerPriority reads getAudioEventInfo()->m_priority. Leftover game_audio.rs:2045 uses get_audio_priority never set from info. Player-visible: HIGH combat sounds culled while LOWEST ambients hog channels.

description: C++ SpawnBehavior + QueueProductionExitUpdate InitialBurst=5 ExitDelay=5000 → 5 instant then one/5s. Live host_angry_mob apply_due_expands spawns all 10 at frame 0. Player-visible every GLA mob.

description: C++ SpectreGunshipDeploymentUpdate selectObject + SpectreGunshipUpdate setSpecialPowerOverridableDestination/VoiceAttack. Live HostSpectreOrbitField is fixed-position. Player-visible: cannot steer the gunship reticle.

description: C++ ScriptActions.cpp:4121/4217 fire special powers from scripts. Leftover implements against empty crate registry without host bridge. Player-visible: campaign scripted special-power fires no-op.

title: Live special-power targeting skips ActionManager underwater and fully-shrouded gates
description: C++ ActionManager.cpp:1439-1523 underwater (Paradrop/CrateDrop) + shrouded-cell gates for ~30 damaging powers. Leftover can_do_special_power_at_location unused. Live command_executor/special_power.rs has no shroud/underwater legality.

title: [Weapon] Splash NOT_SIMILAR compares exact template names, not isEquivalentTo
description: C++ Weapon.cpp:1344-1348 + ThingTemplate::isEquivalentTo reskin/buildVariation. Live combat.rs exact string compare. Reskinned allies lose anti-domino protection.

description: C++ TerrainLogic anyBridgesDamageStatesChanged is a one-frame latch. Live eval_bridge_broken stays true forever. Repeating scripts re-fire every frame.

description: C++ Team::didAllEnter skips non-matching locomotor surfaces and KINDOF_INERT. Live host_script_loco_matches_ground is ground-bit only. Air-only areas never fire.

description: evaluator/dispatch.rs:113 returns false when OBJECT_REGISTRY empty. MissionScriptRuntime and team production conditions stay false.

description: WaitAction no-op, TriggerSystem invented, Rhai unused second brain. Dual-world leftover-only.

description: Live collect_unit_decal_items draws scale*12 grey disc under every drawable. C++ has no fallback blob. Double-draws once real decals land.

description: C++ moveTowardsPositionWheels projects 15 frames ahead and rotate-only if invalid terrain. Live wheeled branch has no lookahead. Trucks drive into water/cliffs on turns.

description: C++ onDrawableSelected setGUICommand(NULL). Live host_set_selection never clears pending_map_command. Arm A then box-select then LMB fires stale power.

description: C++ AutoDepositUpdate addMoneyEarned. Live resources_income.rs credit_supplies only. Score screen undercounts GLA/derrick income.

description: C++ doNamedStop aiIdle. Leftover leftover-only. Live no drain. Scripts cannot halt waves.

description: C++ doTeamHuntWithCommandButton arms CommandButtonHuntUpdate. Live OnCreate maps to unit_command_patrol. Terrorists/car-bombers hunt without their button.

description: C++ MusicManager queues requests. Leftover game_music.rs plays hook directly. Leftover-only until a music-menu caller uses it.

description: C++ SupplyCenterProductionExitUpdate GrantTemporaryStealth=20000. Live only dock-side grant. Kassad camo-netted stash workers instantly exposed.

description: C++ SpectreGunshipUpdate insertion flight, doors, afterburner, departure. Live spawn plan only.

description: C++ GrantStealthBehavior radius particle + flashAsSelected. Live GPS_SCRAMBLER_RADIUS_PARTICLE honesty-only.

description: C++ PopupSaveLoad confirm dialogs. Live SaveLoadMenu saves immediately; sanitize_slot_name collisions overwrite; no delete affordance.

description: C++ xferAsciiString writes byte length + raw bytes. Leftover file-based xfer_save.rs maps each char to one byte with '?' fallback.

description: C++ TheInGameUI->message on success and MessageBoxOk on failure. Live host_save_game_authority only logs.
